machine_assumption: Available Windows AMD64 CPU machine; no CUDA device is required or used.

rf.candidate_model_persistence: metrics/configuration only; candidate model files are not retained

tgnn.search_policy: four predeclared candidates; no exhaustive search beyond the frozen finite space

combined.timeout_action: stop the affected run, retain its transcript, mark the experiment incomplete, and do not inspect test targets or silently alter the plan

checkpoint_storage_limit.retention: best checkpoint per TGNN candidate/final seed only; no RF candidate checkpoints

combined.practicality_constraint: Run the ordered experiments serially on one CPU worker; the four-by-two TGNN candidate space is intentionally finite and avoids an unnecessary exhaustive architecture search.
